analysis.stop_reason: The preregistered stopping condition was met: only the fully matched A1B1 cell regressed, and its Mixed result reproduced exactly. Both mixed cells and the all-quantity cell remained Human. This identifies a stable, boundary-local two-clause interaction; further subdivision would be token hunting and is unlikely to yield a general editorial rule.
analysis.summary: The endpoint separation reproduced: AI_ENDPOINT was AI (1.000) and the editorially preferred HUMAN_ENDPOINT was Human (0.000). On the fixed Human-endpoint backbone, A0B0, A0B1, and A1B0 were all Human (0.000), while A1B1 was Mixed (0.37697 AI fraction). Thus neither part-predicate clause was sufficient alone; the detector regression required their joint matched realization in this boundary. Exact repeats reproduced every result. HUMAN_ENDPOINT remains the editorial authority.
supported: The supplied endpoint anchor is stable: AI_ENDPOINT remained AI and HUMAN_ENDPOINT remained Human on exact repeat.

A boundary-local A×B interaction is supported: the fully matched “the romantic part is … and the selfless part is …” realization regressed to Mixed while the other three factorial cells remained Human.
The joint contrast was substantial and stable: A0B0→A1B1 increased AI fraction by 0.37697 and flipped Human→Mixed.
Each clause’s effect was conditional on the other matched-part clause: both conditional contrasts at the matched level were +0.37697, whereas both contrasts at the quantity level were 0.
The two opposite mixed cells were identical at the reported endpoint level—both Human with AI fraction 0—so neither half carried the effect independently.
HUMAN_ENDPOINT remains preferred on blind editorial quality and fidelity grounds; the detector result supplies no reason to replace it with a synthetic probe.
unresolved: Whether this two-clause interaction generalizes to other passages, meanings, or detector boundaries remains unknown.
The distributed syntactic, rhythmic, and contextual features underlying the interaction are not identified; the experiment does not support a universal phrase or word rule.
Whether publication-quality alternative realizations show the same interaction remains untested, but pursuing finer contrasts here would violate the stop rule and risk token hunting.
